Question Choices: Which data set has more variability? A: 5, 5, 5, 5, 5     B: 1, 9, 3, 7, 2
Hints: Compare maximum minus minimum for each data set.
Solution: Range A=5−5=0; range B=9−1=8. B has the greater range and more variability by this measure.

Question Choices: Select. Is this a statistical question? "How tall is my teacher?" ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: Look for a collection of observations whose values may vary; yes/no responses also count as data.
Solution: This asks for one person’s height at the stated time, a single measurement. It does not anticipate a distribution of varying observations, so it is not statistical.

Question Choices: Select. Is this a statistical question? "What is the average shoe size of students in the school?" ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: Look for a collection of observations whose values may vary; yes/no responses also count as data.
Solution: This asks about measurements across students or across multiple days. It anticipates variation in those observations and can be answered by collecting and analyzing data, so it is statistical.

Hints: Compare maximum minus minimum for each data set.
Solution: Range A=60−60=0; range B=75−55=20. B has the greater range and more variability by this measure.
